faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Simple answers about privacy, data, and how tracking works.
faq.a1: NephroReach is an educational platform designed to empower individuals living with chronic kidney disease (CKD), dialysis patients, kidney transplant recipients, and their caregivers through reliable education, practical tools, and ongoing support.
faq.a2: No. NephroReach is not a medical practice and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or emergency care. Our content is educational and should never replace advice from your healthcare provider.
faq.a3:
Our platform is designed for:

* Individuals with chronic kidney disease (CKD)
* Hemodialysis patients
* Peritoneal dialysis patients
* Kidney transplant recipients
* Family members and caregivers
* Individuals preparing to start dialysis

If a person does not have kidney issues but would like to utilize the personal logs, that's an option too.
faq.a4:
Depending on your membership level, you may receive:

* Kidney disease education library
* Health trackers and journals
* Diet and nutrition resources
* Medication tracking tools
* Blood pressure and weight logs
* Live educational classes
* Q&A sessions with kidney care professionals
* Caregiver resources
* Downloadable educational materials
faq.q5: Can NephroReach replace my nephrologist or healthcare provider?
faq.a5: No. NephroReach is designed to complement your medical care by helping you better understand your condition and become a more informed participant in your healthcare.
faq.q6: Are the educational materials created by healthcare professionals?
faq.a6: Yes. Our educational content is developed and reviewed by experienced kidney care professionals to provide accurate, evidence-based information.
faq.a7: Yes. Caregivers are encouraged to participate and have access to educational resources designed specifically to help them support their loved ones.
faq.q8: How often is new content added?
faq.a8: New educational articles, videos, webinars, and resources are added regularly to keep members informed with current kidney care information.
faq.a9: Yes. Most live educational sessions are recorded so members can watch them later if they are unable to attend.
faq.q10: Can I ask questions during live sessions?
faq.a10: Yes. Members attending live educational sessions can submit questions during designated Q&A periods.
faq.q11: What should I do if I have a medical emergency?
faq.a11: Call 911 immediately or go to your nearest emergency department. Do not rely on NephroReach for emergency medical advice.
faq.a12: Yes. Any health logs or information you choose to enter are entered voluntarily and are intended for your personal use. NephroReach does not view, monitor, or have access to the personal information you record in your private logs. You remain responsible for the information you choose to enter and share.
faq.q13: How do I cancel my membership?
faq.a13: You may cancel your membership at any time through your account settings. Your access will continue through the end of your current billing period.
faq.a14: The information provided on NephroReach is for educational purposes only and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Always consult your physician, nephrologist, dialysis care team, or other qualified healthcare professional before making changes to your healthcare plan.
faq.a15: NephroReach is an educational platform and does not collect or monitor the personal health information you choose to enter into your private tracking tools. Your logs are for your own reference and self-management. If you choose to share information with your healthcare provider or caregiver, that decision is entirely yours.

aboutUsPage.heroTitle: Empowering Member Education Through Smart Notification Engagement
aboutUsPage.heroSubtitle: We create scalable, user-friendly tools that automate check-ins, support digital journaling, and provide access to educational resources and live classes.
aboutUsPage.founderP1: Hello, I’m Joni Gathers, MSN, APRN, FNP-C, a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner with a decade of nephrology and dialysis experience. Throughout my career as both a Dialysis Nurse and Practitioner, I’ve cared for hundreds of patients living with chronic kidney disease (CKD), end-stage kidney disease (ESKD), hypertension, diabetes, and those receiving dialysis.
aboutUsPage.founderP2: Working closely with patients and families, I recognized that many hospitalizations and emergency room visits happen because patients simply don’t have access to understandable, ongoing kidney education outside of their clinic visits. Many leave appointments overwhelmed, unsure of what their lab results mean, how to manage fluid intake, what symptoms require immediate attention, or how to confidently navigate life with kidney disease.
aboutUsPage.founderP3: I created NephroReach to bridge that gap.
aboutUsPage.offer1: On-demand educational videos covering CKD, dialysis, nutrition, medications, lab values, and kidney health.
aboutUsPage.offer2: Live educational sessions with experienced kidney care professionals.
aboutUsPage.offer3: Interactive health tracking tools, including blood pressure, weight, medications, labs, dialysis treatments, and symptoms.
aboutUsPage.offer5: Educational programs that help patients prepare for dialysis and better understand treatment options.
aboutUsPage.offer6: Practical guidance to help patients recognize concerning symptoms, know when to contact their dialysis or nephrology team, and understand when emergency care may be necessary.
aboutUsPage.panelistDesignation: (Kidney Health Coach) LMSW, LPLC, Licensed Masters Social Worker Professional Life Coach
aboutUsPage.panelistP1: I have been practicing professionally in the field for over 3 decades and have built my career supporting individuals, families, and communities as they navigate healthcare challenges and work toward improved well-being. With experience in compassionate care, advocacy, education, and care coordination, I am committed to helping people understand their health needs and access the support they need to thrive.
aboutUsPage.panelistP2: I believe meaningful change begins with education, self-advocacy, and trusted resources. I am passionate about promoting health literacy and empowering individuals to make informed decisions, especially when facing complex medical conditions and healthcare systems. Supporting organizations that serve individuals living with kidney disease is especially important to me because patient education and advocacy can greatly improve quality of life and health outcomes. Through collaboration, empathy, and a person-centered approach, I strive to help patients and families become informed partners in care and contribute to healthier, more empowered communities.
aboutUsPage.panelistTopicsTitle: During sessions I cater to my audience discussing topics such as:
aboutUsPage.panelistTopic1: Navigating familial changes with end stage renal disease
aboutUsPage.panelistTopic2: Addressing and Resolving marital issues with a spouse that has end stage renal disease
aboutUsPage.panelistTopic4: Family Connections: Normalizing household discussions about health, health literacy and healthy outcomes
aboutUsPage.panelistTopic6: Caregivers the one’s that are forgotten
aboutUsPage.nutritionistBio: Annette Weseman is a licensed registered dietitian with 25 years experience in clinical nutrition. She has extensive experience helping individuals manage diabetes and has specialized in renal nutrition for the past 12 years. Annette is passionate about empowering patients with chronic kidney disease to make informed decisions about food, medicine, and healthy lifestyle choices. She is licensed in South Carolina and registered with the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).
aboutUsPage.reviewsTitle: Support that feels practical, clear, and human
aboutUsPage.reviewsSubtitle: A few sample reflections from patients and caregivers who use NephroReach to feel more prepared between appointments.
aboutUsPage.review1Quote: The lessons helped me understand what questions to bring to my dialysis team. I felt more organized and less overwhelmed after the first week.
aboutUsPage.review2Quote: As a caregiver, having simple explanations and reminders made a real difference. It gave our family a calmer way to talk about kidney health.
aboutUsPage.review3Quote: The tracking tools helped me notice patterns before my appointments. I could share clearer notes and make better use of my visit time.
